game.name: Apotris
game.desc: Apotris is a feature-complete Tetris clone for the Game Boy Advance, built by akouzoukos as a passion project and released free of charge. It includes multiple game modes — Marathon, Sprint, Ultra, and more — along with modern Tetris mechanics like hold piece, ghost piece, and T-spin detection. One of the most polished GBA homebrew releases ever made.
